entries.summary: Autoload singletons: GameManager (score/lives/high-score persistence), AudioManager (procedural SFX/music, always-process), and SettingsManager (user://settings.cfg audio/difficulty). SettingsManager is registered but not used by any scene; settings_menu.tscn has no script.

Game scene architecture: Main root spawns Menu; Menu -> Game; Game manages Player, Enemies, Bullets, Powerups, Asteroids, Effects, ScreenFlash, HUD, PauseMenu. Game uses _process collisions, timers for spawn/powerup/wave/asteroid, and direct parent references for projectiles. Retry/menu flows recreate the Game scene under the same holder (Main or root).

Player controls: WASD/arrows to move, SPACE/J shoot, L dash, SHIFT alt scatter. Player has weapon level 0-4 driven by XP from kills, 5 HP, shield, rapid fire, dash. Signals: died, shoot, shoot_spread, hit, powerup_collected, weapon_level_changed. Drawing is fully procedural via _draw.

Enemy system has 6 types (SCOUT, FIGHTER, TANK, BOMBER, SWEEPER, CARRIER). Game spawns single enemies and formations; every 5 waves a Boss spawns with 3 phases. Enemy/boss bullets use enemy_bullet.tscn which reuses bullet.gd. CARRIER spawns minions; boss dies trigger stage progression in game.gd.

Known issues/pitfalls: (1) asteroid.tscn CollisionShape2D has no shape assigned, so asteroid collisions will fail unless assigned at runtime. (2) settings_menu.tscn has no script, so the settings UI is non-functional. (3) player_trail.gd is instantiated by player but never has its tick/reset methods actually connected; the script has class_name PlayerTrail but the created trail just uses default _process logic. (4) BulletPooled and Pool exist but game.gd uses bullet.tscn and queue_free() directly, so the pool is unused. (5) Main.gd only registers alt_shoot and dash input actions as runtime fallbacks; project.godot defines all movement and shoot/pause, but alt_shoot/special are not in project.godot, so menu description may not match actual input.

SettingsManager exists as scripts/settings_manager.gd but is NOT registered as an autoload in project.godot. It is never instantiated in the current flow, and settings_menu.tscn has no script attached, so the settings UI is disconnected.
Asteroid scene (scenes/asteroid.tscn) has a CollisionShape2D node but no shape resource assigned, so asteroid collisions with bullets/player do not work.
PlayerTrail is instantiated by player.gd _spawn_trail() but its tick()/reset() API is never called; the script has no _process() to auto-update, so the trail effect is effectively disabled.
Object pool system (scripts/pool.gd + scripts/bullet_pooled.gd) exists but is not used. game.gd and enemy.gd still instantiate bullets and queue_free them directly.

SettingsManager 存在但 project.godot 的 [autoload] 未注册它，导致单例从未实例化。settings_menu.tscn 只有静态 UI 节点、没有脚本，没有 Sliders/Buttons 等交互控件，所以设置菜单完全无效。SettingsManager 使用 ConfigFile 持久化到 user://settings.cfg，提供 audio (master/sfx/music) 和 game (difficulty) 的 setter/getter/signal 接口。AudioManager 不依赖 SettingsManager，当前音乐音量 hardcoded 为 -10 dB。
PlayerTrail 的 tick()/reset() 目前无人调用：_spawn_trail() 只实例化拖尾场景并把位置设在玩家身后，但从没在玩家 _process 中调用 trail_instance.tick(delta, position)，因此拖尾光点永远不会更新，且节点常驻直到因生命耗尽而自毁（但 life 只在 tick 中减）。

ObjectPool system files: pool.gd (generic Pool Node with acquire/release per scene_path), bullet_pooled.gd (class_name BulletPooled with reset/_deactivate lifecycle). Currently NOT wired into game.gd; enemy.gd/boss.gd still instantiate enemy_bullet.tscn directly, and player shoot handlers in game.gd use load().instantiate()/queue_free(). To integrate: switch bullet.tscn/enemy_bullet.tscn script to bullet_pooled.gd; add Pool instance in game.gd; implement return_bullet() and spawn_bullet(); route all bullet creation/destruction through pool; make enemy.gd/boss.gd call game.spawn_bullet() instead of preload.instantiate().

Save system is implemented with SaveManager autoload (res://scripts/save_manager.gd) registered in project.godot. It persists score, high_score, wave, lives plus version/timestamp to user://save.json. Pause menu has Center/SaveGame and Center/LoadGame buttons wired to save and load via SaveManager. Game wave end points _on_wave_timer_timeout and _on_boss_killed both call _save_progress() for auto-save. Pause menu load validates required fields before calling game.apply_save_data. SaveManager has no class_name because it is an autoload.

Player currently has a built-in weapon_level (0-4) and weapon_xp system in player.gd. fire() hard-codes bullet patterns by weapon_level. HUD already has _weapon_level tracking and shows WAVE as W{n} Lv.{level}. Powerup enum has types HEAL/RAPID_FIRE/SHIELD/BOMB/SCORE_X2. When implementing WeaponSystem autoload, the existing per-level patterns and HUD label should be replaced/extended with type+level display.

Player shooting now uses WeaponSystem autoload. player.gd signals shoot/shoot_spread pass a 4th Dictionary argument with damage, speed, color. game.gd _on_player_shoot and _on_player_shoot_spread consume this extra dict. weapon_system.gd now has WeaponType enum, WEAPON_TYPE_* constants, WEAPON_COUNT, and get_weapon_data(type, level) returning damage, fire_rate, bullet_count, bullet_speed, spread, color.
